name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood in Lyon, where he spent countless hours tinkering with engines alongside his grandfather, a retired mechanic. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, graduating top of his class before joining a Formula Renault team as a junior engineer. Over the years, he honed his skills, developing a reputation for meticulousness and a knack for optimizing vehicle performance under pressure.

He joined Speed Kart Racing three years ago, quickly rising to the position of chief engineer. Jean-Pierre is known for his pragmatic approach, prioritizing data-driven decisions and fostering a collaborative environment within the engineering team. He believes in continuous improvement and encourages his team to challenge conventional wisdom, always seeking innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. What sets Jean-Pierre apart is his ability to remain calm and focused, even during the most stressful race weekends, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is a slender man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on cleaning his workspace at the end of each day.
